protocol.name: Anormal Gün Devamı v1
protocol.signal: close/previous close-1; mean and sample SD ddof=1 of preceding 90 daily returns excluding signal day; inclusive z >= 2 / <= -2
protocol.atr: daily Wilder ATR14, mean seed of first 14 true ranges; signal day included; a missing calendar interval is not fabricated and starts a new ATR seed; recent return window with a gap is unverified
protocol.universe: first UTC day of each month, previous 30 closed daily bars quote volume; top20, minimum120 daily history; historical catalogue, not current TRADING list
protocol.entry: next daily open; exact timestamp ties expire old positions first, then choose largest absolute z, symbol as deterministic tie-break
protocol.exit: 24h boundary next-hour open; emergency stop checked hourly with open-gap fills, intrahour stop level at last millisecond of that hour; unresolved intrahour funding order unverified
protocol.funding: actual signed rates on fixed entry notional; entry < settlement <= exit, milliseconds floored to seconds; missing series never replaced with zero
protocol.control: one uniform same-coin same-signal-calendar-month |z|<1 observed day per signal; seed20261023 hash per signal; with replacement; pool frozen before outcomes; retrospective comparison only, no role in live signals; no control resampling after failures
protocol.control_portfolio: for each accepted actual signal its matched independent control, not a separately capacity-filtered portfolio; duplicates and temporal dependence disclosed
protocol.supplementary: same accepted main signal IDs held48h with emergency stop, or24h without stop; no new selection or capacity refill; not used to choose rules
protocol.capital: 10000USDT, each entry current equity risk1%; 0.15% entry plus0.15% exit on original notional; UTC boundary equity, not intraday drawdown; no margin/liquidation model
protocol.success: limited main24h only, six user conditions plus data must be verified; below200 YETERSIZ VERI; no tuning
protocol.annual: exit calendar year, partial first/last years included; last12months by exit date; best3 by total net percentage then excluded from unchanged trade list
protocol.data_repair: original monthly archive gaps completed from official daily archive, or all24 official hourly bars if available; every repair logged; no edits to original Turtle inputs
protocol.live: disabled until GEÇTİ and explicit report-bound user approval; daily00:07UTC; scheduler cannot guarantee exact execution, actual entry/exit timestamps and late-exit delay recorded; minute data only trims partial live entry/exit hours, no minute signals
